description: This file defines the 'Delete' feature for managing favorite articles in the application. It includes a command for removing a favorite article based on a slug, a validator for input validation, and a request handler that performs the database operations to remove the favorite and return the updated article envelope.

classes.name: Delete
classes.description: Contains the command, validator, and handler for deleting a favorite article based on its slug.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles the process of removing a favorite article for the current user, updating the database, and returning the updated article envelope.
